claims: The 2026 Los Angeles Dodgers open their season at home against the Arizona Diamondbacks on Thursday, March 26, 2026, at 5:30 p.m. PT.
The 2026 Los Angeles Dodgers season opener will be broadcast on NBC.
The 2026 Los Angeles Dodgers season opener will be streamed on Peacock.
The 2026 Los Angeles Dodgers season opener features a pitching duel between Yoshinobu Yamamoto and Arizona's Zac Gallen.
According to MLB.com, the Los Angeles Dodgers will hold a ceremony to celebrate their 2025 championship before the game.
The opening day details include opponent Arizona Diamondbacks.
The opening day details include location Dodger Stadium, Los Angeles.
The opening day details include time 5:30 p.m. PT.
The opening day pitchers are Yoshinobu Yamamoto (LAD) vs. Zac Gallen (ARI).
The opening day TV/Streaming is NBC and Peacock.
According to True Blue LA, Alex Freeland has earned a spot on the opening day roster.
The pregame ceremony includes a 2025 championship banner raising.
According to NBC Los Angeles, new stadium menu items include a Cochinita Pibil Bone Marrow Taco.
According to NBC Los Angeles, new stadium menu items include a Loco Moco Bowl.
According to True Blue LA, Clayton Kershaw will be part of the on-site pregame show on NBC.
